s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive, symmetric lower extremity weakness with urinary retention and cranial nerve involvement
salient_findings: Subacute, progressive, symmetric lower extremity weakness
Nodular thickening and enhancement of the lumbosacral nerve roots
key_facts: MRI brain and orbits showed no abnormality
MRI spine showed nodular thickening and enhancement of lumbosacral nerve roots
Diffuse heterogeneous T1- and T2-weighted signal abnormalities within bone marrow
Cerebrospinal fluid analysis showed elevated white blood cell count
Cerebrospinal fluid analysis showed elevated red blood cell count

raw.syndrome_frame: Progressive, symmetric lower extremity weakness with urinary retention and cranial nerve involvement
salient_findings: Subacute, progressive, symmetric lower extremity weakness
Nodular thickening and enhancement of the lumbosacral nerve roots
key_facts: MRI brain and orbits showed no abnormality
MRI spine showed nodular thickening and enhancement of lumbosacral nerve roots
Diffuse heterogeneous T1- and T2-weighted signal abnormalities within bone marrow
Cerebrospinal fluid analysis showed elevated white blood cell count
Cerebrospinal fluid analysis showed elevated red blood cell count

differentials: Leukoencephalopathy with brainstem and spinal cord involvement and lactate elevation
per_call: Leukoencephalopathy with brainstem and spinal cord involvement and lactate elevation

shortlist.label: Acute myeloid leukemia
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of violaceous cutaneous lesions (leukemia cutis) and elevated atypical cells/blasts in cerebrospinal fluid analysis

shortlist.label: Plasma cell leukemia
shortlist.why_kept: Diffuse heterogeneous T1- and T2-weighted signal abnormalities within bone marrow and presence of severe flaccid quadriparesis

shortlist.label: POEMS syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: Progressive, symmetric lower extremity weakness, urinary retention, and cranial nerve involvement

shortlist.label: Neurolymphomatosis
shortlist.why_kept: Severe flaccid quadriparesis, reduced muscle stretch reflexes, and presence of atypical cells/blasts in cerebrospinal fluid analysis

shortlist.label: Intravascular large B-cell lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of violaceous cutaneous lesions and elevated white blood cell count in cerebrospinal fluid analysis

raw.rationale: The patient's presentation of subacute, progressive, symmetric lower extremity weakness, urinary retention, and violaceous cutaneous lesions, along with the MRI findings of nodular thickening and enhancement of the lumbosacral nerve roots and diffuse heterogeneous signal abnormalities within the bone marrow, is consistent with POEMS syndrome, a rare paraneoplastic syndrome associated with a plasma cell disorder.

rejected.label: Acute myeloid leukemia
rejected.why: While the patient has elevated white blood cell count and atypical cells/blasts in the cerebrospinal fluid, the clinical presentation and imaging findings are more consistent with POEMS syndrome.

rejected.label: Plasma cell leukemia
rejected.why: The patient's presentation is not typical for plasma cell leukemia, which is usually characterized by a higher burden of plasma cells in the blood and bone marrow.

rejected.label: Neurolymphomatosis
rejected.why: The patient's imaging findings and cerebrospinal fluid analysis do not support a diagnosis of neurolymphomatosis, which typically involves infiltration of the nervous system by lymphoma cells.

rejected.label: Intravascular large B-cell lymphoma
rejected.why: The patient's presentation and imaging findings are not consistent with intravascular large B-cell lymphoma, which typically involves the presence of lymphoma cells within the blood vessels.
